game_concept: A action puzzle set in Coastal Port – Island Ferry, the island ferry landing: the sailor must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Island Ferry: the island ferry landing
core_gameplay_loop: In Island Ferry, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely. Each round, a new anchors challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stealth value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 130 points of anchors by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Not Negator' (Week 3 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Island Ferry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Island Ferry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 50 seconds.
